meta.title: Our Street
meta.textType: functional: a description of a place with a map

paragraphs: Hello! I'm May, and this is my street. I live here with my brother Pat. Look at my map. My white house is next to the school. The cinema is between my house and the supermarket. The library is opposite the cinema. The bus stop is near the library. There is a car park behind the supermarket. A small shop is next to the car park. Our street is in a small town. It is not big, but it is very nice.

Pat asks, "Where is the library, May?" "Go straight on," I say. "Go to the cinema. The library is opposite." "Is the bus stop near?" asks Pat. "Yes, it is near the library," I say. "Can we go to the supermarket, too?" asks Pat. "Yes, go straight on. It is after the cinema." Pat likes books about animals. We go to the library every Saturday.

Then we go to the cinema for a film. Pat is always hungry after the film! He is tired too. I like my street. It is small, but there are many nice places. Do you have a street like this? What is near your house? Now draw a map of your street!
text.summary: May describes her street and shows it on a map. She tells her brother Pat how to walk to the library and the bus stop.
